subject: Ninja
text: Upon class change, the Ninja gains the ability to use some Black Magic, including FAST.

evidence.quote: The Ninja can also use some Black Magic, including FAST, probably the best magic in the game.

subject: Knight
text: Upon class change, the Knight can use some White Magic such as CURE and CUR2.

evidence.quote: He can use some White Magic!!! Well, it's not much, but having some extra cure magic does help.  He can get magic such as CURE and CUR2, but his lack of intelligence makes his magic somewhat ineffective.

subject: White Wizard
text: The White Wizard can learn FADE, a high-level spell dealing about 200-400 damage to all enemies.

evidence.quote: FADE will cause about 200-400 damage on all enemies, which can be helpful at times when you just want to get rid of a bunch of guys without worrying about defense, but rater how fast you can kill them all (4 Frost Dragons can never be good).

subject: WarMech
text: A party with a Fighter and two Red Mages can defeat WarMech using support spells like INV2, ARUB, FOG2, FAST, and CUR3.

evidence.quote: The firepower of the Fighter and 2 Red Mages really can knock out a WarMech no problem when combined with the support of INV2, ARUB, FOG2, FAST, and CUR3 from your Mages.

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: Inside the Temple of Fiends, go left into the treasure room to find a Cap.

evidence.quote: Now, go to the left and into the treasure room for find a cap.

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: Other treasure chests in the Temple of Fiends contain a Cabin and a HEAL potion.

evidence.quote: Then, go up to the other treasure chests and pick up a CABIN and a HEAL potion.

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: A HEAL potion can be collected from the other treasure chests inside the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote: Then, go up to the other treasure chests and pick up a CABIN and a HEAL potion.

subject: Peninsula of Power
text: Stacking 8-10 layers of RUSE and INVS makes characters almost impossible to hit against a Giant on the Peninsula of Power.

evidence.quote: However, if you combine RUSE and INVS against a Giant from Power Peninsula, with about 8-10 layers of RUSE/INVS, you will be almost impossible to hit.
